entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Razor: split component referencing a fallback component's nested delegate/enum loses metadata (decl/impl split) #84646
  • Debug Build fails with System.InvalidOperationException: Did not find Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.BoundConversion `default` in the map. #84642
  • Debug Build fails with System.InvalidOperationException: _returnTypesOpt is not null || _disableDiagnostics on ToString incorrectly used in ternary #84641
  • Diagnostics from AfterMembersCompletedChecks aren't available from GetDiagnostics with a span filter #84638
    Backlog
  • VisualBasic.Grammar.g4: required list children emitted as '*' instead of '+' (HandleList ignores optionality; C# generator honors MinCount) #84636
    Backlog
  • VisualBasic.Grammar.g4: invalid ANTLR escape '\=' for IntegerDivideEqualsToken (file unparseable) #84635
    Backlog
  • VisualBasic.Grammar.g4: multi-line lambda rules drop the lambda header and swap End Sub/End Function #84634
    Backlog
  • VisualBasic.Grammar.g4: three rules defined twice (structure vs. node-kind name collision in GrammarGenerator) #84633
    Backlog

Closed

  • No more highlighting in razor editor #84106
  • Quick info and diagnostics in C# stops working after opening a Razor file for the second time #84400
  • when i collapse an @if in a .razor file, i get the subsequent stuff in the same line #84617
    Backlog
  • DirectiveParser roots Assembly.Location and blocks Native AOT consumers #84574
    18.10
  • PairedExtensionOperatorSignatureComparer.Equals compares a containing type of the LHS to itself #84538
    Backlog
  • Razor formatting not honoring Visual Studio formatting options for C# code blocks within .razor files #84608
  • SyntaxNode actions related to unions trigger multiple times #84570
    18.10
